package virtual_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"ponder.local/ponder-go/config"
	"ponder.local/ponder-go/indexing"
	"virtual.test/app"
)

func TestRegisterGeneratedBlock(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var req struct {
			ID     any
			Method string
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil || req.Method != "eth_getBlockByNumber" {
			t.Errorf("unexpected build request: %s, %v", req.Method, err)
			return
		}
		block := map[string]any{
			"hash": "0x" + strings.Repeat("1", 64), "parentHash": "0x" + strings.Repeat("0", 64),
			"number": "0xa", "timestamp": "0x64", "logsBloom": "0x" + strings.Repeat("0", 512),
		}
		if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": req.ID, "result": block}); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	cfg, err := config.ParseSourceConfiguration([]byte(`{"chains":{"mainnet":{"id":1,"reorgWindow":0,"rpc":` + strconv.Quote(server.URL) + `}},"blocks":{"b1":{"chain":"mainnet","interval":2,"startBlock":1}}}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	base, err := config.BuildSourceConfig(cfg, config.SourceBuildOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	event := app.NameB1Block{}
	called := false
	reg := event.IndexingFunction(func(_ context.Context, args *indexing.HandlerArgs) error {
		chain, err := event.Chain(args.Context)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		called = chain.Name() == "mainnet" && chain.ID() == 1
		return nil
	})
	build, err := config.BuildSourceIndexing(t.Context(), cfg, base, []config.SourceIndexingFunction{reg})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	live := build.Executable()
	if len(live.EventCallbacks) != 1 || len(live.EventCallbacks[0]) != 1 || live.EventCallbacks[0][0]["name"] != "b1:block" {
		t.Fatal(live.EventCallbacks)
	}
	if err := live.IndexingFunctions[0]["fn"].(indexing.Handler)(t.Context(), &indexing.HandlerArgs{Context: &indexing.Context{Chain: live.Chains[0]}}); err != nil || !called {
		t.Fatalf("registered callback: %v, %v", called, err)
	}
}
